title: azalea campylogyna
intro: Azalea campylogyna, commonly known as the "wild azalea" or "Chinese azalea," is a plant species in the heath family, Ericaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Azalea campylogyna include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties, which may help to lower blood pressure and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
